title: Geometric Chow modification data
statement: Let A be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], Z a nonempty Noetherian scheme, and f : Z → Spec A separated and of finite type [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. There exist Y, a proper q : Y → Z, an ideal sheaf L on Z, a natural number n, and an immersion e : Y → ProjectiveSpace (ULift (Fin (n+1))) (Spec A) over Spec A, meaning e followed by projection equals q followed by f. The complement of L.support is nonempty, and the second projection of the pullback of q along that open inclusion is an isomorphism.

source.place: Theorem 088E, paragraphs 2--4 (closed quotient, Chow modification, projective algebraization and proper push-pull comparison); verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/088E

proof.text: Apply ChowModification.nonempty_data to f over the Noetherian scheme Spec A. Extract its source Y, proper surjective map q, finite coordinate type N, immersion into ProjectiveSpace N (Spec A), equation over Spec A, and dense open U on which the restriction of q is an isomorphism. Since Z is nonempty and q is surjective, Y is nonempty. Projective space with an empty coordinate type is empty, so N is nonempty. Choose a finite enumeration N ≃ ULift (Fin (n + 1)), with n one less than its positive cardinality. Renaming homogeneous variables induces an isomorphism of projective spaces over Spec A. Compose the extracted immersion with this isomorphism to obtain e; composition preserves immersion and the equation over Spec A. Take L to be the vanishing ideal of the reduced closed complement of U. The reduced complement theorem identifies its support with that complement, hence L.support.compl with U. Density of U and nonemptiness of Z imply U is nonempty. Finally the canonical isomorphism from the pullback along U.ι to the restricted source identifies pullback.snd with q restricted to U. Transport the restriction isomorphism along this identification and the equality U = L.support.compl. These constructions supply all asserted data.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_chow_modification_data
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] (f : Z ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (hZ : Nonempty Z) :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (q : Y ⟶ Z) (_ : IsProper q) (L : Z.IdealSheafData)
      (n : ℕ)
      (e : Y ⟶ ProjectiveSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) (Spec (.of A))),
      IsImmersion e ∧
      e ≫ (ProjectiveSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) (Spec (.of A)) ↘ Spec (.of A)) =
        q ≫ f ∧
      (L.support.compl : Set Z).Nonempty ∧
      IsIso (pullback.snd q (Scheme.Opens.ι L.support.compl))
